description_en: Grants permissions on cloud desktops to end users, or revokes the permissions from the end users
description_zh: 为一个或多个用户新增或删除指定的一台或多台云电脑的授权
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-user-entitlement --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --end-user-id Alice --authorize-desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --revoke-desktop-id ecd-j45qtb0eh91yg0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserEntitlement

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud computers to which you want to add end users
parameters.help_zh: 要新增授权用户的云电脑ID列表
parameters.name: authorize_desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud computers whose end users you want to remove
parameters.help_zh: 要删除授权用户的云电脑ID列表
parameters.name: revoke_desktop_id
